record.question: Who is the Prime Minister of United Kingdom?
record.explanation: Answer C: Gordon Brown. The UK government records Gordon Brown as Prime Minister in 2007–2010, covering the explicitly printed exam date 24 March 2010. Historical/source note: Historical date is essential: this is not a current Prime Minister question. Reference: https://www.gov.uk/government/history/past-prime-ministers/gordon-brown. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
